# netcup_scp_server_interface_firewall (Resource)

Manages the firewall configuration for a server network interface.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netcup_scp_server_interface_firewall" "example" {
  server_id = 12345
  mac       = "00:50:56:00:00:01"
  active    = true

  copied_policy_ids = [1, 2]
  user_policy_ids   = [10]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `mac` (String) MAC address of the network interface.
- `server_id` (Number) ID of the server.

### Optional

- `active` (Boolean) Whether the firewall is active.
- `copied_policy_ids` (List of Number) IDs of copied firewall policies to apply.
- `user_policy_ids` (List of Number) IDs of user-defined firewall policies to apply.

### Read-Only

- `consistent` (Boolean) Reports whether the firewall configuration is consistent.
- `egress_implicit_rule` (String) Implicit egress rule, either ACCEPT_ALL or DROP_ALL.
- `id` (String) Terraform identifier in the form 'server_id/mac'.
- `ingress_implicit_rule` (String) Implicit ingress rule, either ACCEPT_ALL or DROP_ALL.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# terraform import netcup_scp_server_interface_firewall.example 12345/00:50:56:00:00:01
```
